採用・広告の製品.quote: Improve productivity, safety and sustainability with logistics automation solutions for moving cargo in container terminals, manufacturing facilities and distribution centers.
Reduce risks and free up personnel with FERNRIDE’s proven ground autonomy platform for unmanned vehicles.

FERNRIDE’s autonomous trucks can automate cargo movements between ports, facilities, and logistics hubs, extending yard trucking benefits to open-road logistics for greater productivity and efficiency.
Automate your yard operations with FERNRIDE's reliable, autonomous shunting solution, improving productivity and reducing inefficiencies.
FERNRIDE delivers a comprehensive ground autonomy platform designed to automate operations in the most demanding, repetitive and high-risk environments.

Contact us to learn how FERNRIDE's autonomous solution can accelerate your transition to automated and green operations. Our technology integrates with your existing processes, improving productivity, safety, and sustainability while delivering immediate ROI.
Moving forward into zero-emissions sustainable logistics powered by electric vehicles and future-proof technology.

Safety first: protect your workers and the success of your everyday operations. Human-machine collaboration and guaranteed reliability ensure that you’ve safely and effectively achieved your targets at the end of every shift.
Eliminate inefficiencies, increase your operational productivity, and redefine the role of drivers while boosting their output.
We are proud to have strong partners and venture capitals supporting our vision and driving our growth.

"In terms of potential, Fernride plays in the same league as our previous early-stage investments such as Volocopter or Luminar. For me, the team is already one of the strongest in Europe. I am convinced that Hendrik and his team will make a decisive contribution on the road to autonomous driving. We are proud to support Fernride on this journey."

Hendrik studied industrial engineering at TUM and Stanford and was recognized as a Forbes 30 Under 30 and Logistics Leader of the Year 2024. As CEO, he leads FERNRIDE in building a global platform for industrial automation.

With over 15 years at Audi launching successful L2 and L3 ADAS products, Thomas led teams developing L4 autonomous systems across Europe before joining FERNRIDE. As CTO/COO, he bridges product development and deployment, ensuring seamless customer integration.

With over 15 years of experience at Goldman Sachs, Barclays, and Forto, and degrees in Mathematics and Economics from Wellesley College and an MBA from Yale, Candice leads People & Culture and the CEO Office at FERNRIDE, shaping an engaged and high-performing team.

Klaus is founder and CEO of K2Elevation, a company that invests in international enterprises in the technology segment. He was Chairman and CEO of Alcoa/Arconic. Previously, Klaus had a 20-year career with Siemens and became CEO of Siemens AG in 2005.

Holger has more than 30 years of leadership experience in general management, sales, procurement and organizational strategy. His career includes executive positions such as CEO and board member at Volkswagen/MAN Group, Caterpillar and Volvo.

Thomas is the former CEO of HENSOLDT AG, having led the company from 2015 until recently. He previously held senior executive roles at Astrium, EADS, and Airbus, and now serves on the supervisory board of Airbus Defense and Space. Throughout his career, he has built a track record of driving growth and innovation in aerospace and defense.
